content: गव्य {%a.%} [गवे हितं यत्] .²1 Consisting of cattle or cows. .²2 Coming or got from a cow (as milk, curds <ab>&c.</ab>); गव्येन दत्ते श्राद्धे तु संवत्सरमिहोच्यते <ls>Mb. 13. 88. 8</ls>. .²3 Proper or fit for cattle. .²4 Sacred to the cow, worshipping the cow. .{@-व्यम्@} .²1 Cattle, a herd of cows; गव्यं यव्यं यन्तो <ls>Rv. 1. 140. 13</ls>. .²2 Pasture-land. .²3 The milk, curds <ab>&c.</ab> of a cow; <ls>Mb. 13. 66. 13</ls>. .²4 A bow-string; श्रवणोपान्तिकनीयमानगव्यम् <ls>Śi. 20. 19</ls>. .²5 Colouring substance, yellow pigment. .²6 The sacrificial act called गवामयनम्; गव्यस्य च तदादिषु <ls>MS. 8. 1. 18</ls>; गव्यमिति गवामयनं ब्रूमः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 8. 1. 18</ls>. .{@-व्या@} .²1 A herd of cows. .²2 A measure of distance equal to two Krośas. .²3 A bow-string. .²4 A colouring substance, yellow pigment.
